resources.string: Where will your scrolling take you?
Pick the social apps that eat your day and set a daily limit. Every day you stay under it fuels a rocket on its way from Earth to Pluto.
No account, no server, no location. Scroll Journey only reads how many minutes you spend in the apps you choose.
To count your minutes in each app, Android needs you to switch on Usage Access for Scroll Journey. It only tells us how long apps were open, never what you did inside them.
2. Find Scroll Journey in the list
4. Come back. We’ll detect it automatically
Scroll Journey can now read how long your apps are used. Next up: choosing which apps to track.
Enable it to continue tracking your selected apps.
